title: Midas Client Portal
features: One-stop customer portal for commercial facility services clients
View properties (sites) and the recurring services at each
Submit a new service request with photos
Request a change to an existing service (frequency, scope, pause)
Track job status: Requested, Scheduled, In progress, Completed
View completed work with before/after photo gallery
Support chat and contact the Midas team
Notifications for visit scheduled, crew on site, job completed, invoice issued
Jobber-backed jobs, visits and requests (GraphQL integration layer)
GoHighLevel lead intake for new service requests
Web, iOS and Android from one codebase

bottomTabBar.note: Home = house icon, Requests = clipboard-list icon, Invoices = receipt icon, Support = message-circle icon. Rounded outline 24px icons. Active tab: ink #1F1C0C icon + label with a small lemon #FFD60A pill indicator behind the icon; inactive tabs in #6B6650. Flat white bar, hairline top border #ECE6D2, safe-area bottom inset.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top app header: screen title in Unbounded 20/600 on the left; on Home a round customer avatar (Northgate Office Park facilities manager) on the right plus a bell icon with a lemon unread dot. Pushed screens show a left back chevron.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, lemon #FFD60A fill with ink #1F1C0C label (pressed #E6C000, disabled 40% opacity). Secondary button: white with 1px #8F8A72 border and ink label. Text input: 12px radius, white, border #8F8A72, focus ring #FFD60A 2px, error #DC2626. Card: 20px radius, white, soft shadow. Chip: pill, #FFF6C7 fill, ink #1F1C0C text. Status chips: Requested = sky tint #E3F0FF with #1F4F8A text; Scheduled = lemon tint #FFF6C7 with #6B5600 text; In progress = amber tint #FDEBD3 with #8A4B00 text; Completed = green tint #DDF3E4 with #166534 text.

designSystem.frame: 393x852 mobile (iPhone 16/17). Safe areas: top ~59px, bottom ~34px kept clear.

type.numeralFamily: Plus Jakarta Sans (tabular) - amounts, invoice numbers, counts
type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)
type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.icons: Rounded outline (Lucide style), 24px, ~1.75 stroke, one set everywhere
designSystem.a11y: Lemon #FFD60A carries ink #1F1C0C labels only (never white). White labels only on ink #1F1C0C or accentFill #877105. Status chips always icon + text. Tap targets >=44x44pt.

results.pair: accentFill as link text on background
warning text on its tint and on surface
success text on its tint and on surface
danger text on its tint and on surface
info text on its tint and on surface
support as chart line / icon on surface (non-text 3:1)
